description: Key prefixes approved for publication to the public R2 bucket (boundaries-data, served at https://data.civgraph.net). Writing an object under one of these prefixes publishes it to the open internet immediately. scripts/lib/r2-publication-gate.mjs refuses uploads to any key not covered here.
howToAddAPrefix: Add an entry with prefix, rationale, and evidence, then have it reviewed in the same commit as the upload that needs it. Do not add a prefix speculatively.
seedNote: Seeded 2026-08-05 from prefixes ALREADY serving publicly. These entries record observed production state; they are not a retrospective grant of approval. Rights reviewed 2026-08-05: every census prefix is Crown copyright under Open Government Licence v3.0 per the agent/ READMEs cited below, corroborated by the 'censusNisraOgl' rights code already used in approved-publication-sources.json.

prefixes.rationale: Canonical store for boundary geometry (FGB + compression variants) and per-map JSON indexes. The repo deliberately does not track these.
prefixes.evidence: .gitignore:158 'All FGBs in data/maps/ - R2 (data.civgraph.net) is the canonical source'; functions/data/maps/[[path]].js serves this prefix; verified live 2026-08-05 via preflight-data-migration.mjs
prefixes.rights: per-source; recorded on the individual Browse source records

prefixes.rationale: Tailte Eireann National Land Cover 2018, CC BY 4.0 (verified from the ArcGIS item licenseInfo; data.gov.ie records no licence at all). Mirrored because the 48.5 GB GeoPackage could not complete an Internet Archive upload -- a single 5.5-hour stream was reset with nothing to resume. R2 multipart is resumable.
prefixes.evidence: archive.org/details/civgraph-tailte-national-land-cover-2018 holds the FileGDB original; this is the GeoPackage form of the same layer (NATIONAL_LAND_COVER_MAP_ITM, 10,114,816 features, EPSG:2157, verified identical with ogrinfo).
